BETWEEN:-
 SMT. PREMRANI CHOUDHARY W/O SHRI PAPPU  CHOUDHARY, AGED ABOUT 49 YEARS, OCCUPATION:
 HOUSE WIFE R/O CHOUDHARY MOHALLA MAVERA  TAHSIL JABERA DISTT.DAMOH (MADHYA PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI B. J. CHOURASIYA - ADVOCATE)

AND  THE STATE OF MADHYA PRADESH THROUGH POLICE  STATION JABERA DISTRICT DAMOH (MADHYA  PRADESH)
 
 (BY SHRI VINAY SHARMA - PANEL LAWYER )
 This application coming on for admission this day, the c  following:
 ORDER

This is the 4th bail application filed by the applicant under Section 439 of the Cr.P.C. for grant of bail relating to FIR No. 86/2023 dated 11.3.2023 registered at Police Station- Jabera, District Damoh for commission of the offence under Sections 498A, 304B, 34 of IPC and Section 3/4 of Dowry Prohibition Act.

2. Applicant's earlier bail applications were dismissed as withdrawn vide order dated 21.4.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.14314/2023, order dated 4.5.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.19076/2023 and order dated 10.7.2023 passed in M.Cr.C. No.28183/2023.
3.

As per prosecution story, on 5.3.2023 Rashmi Choudhary, daughter- in-law of the present applicant, committed suicide by hanging herself in her matrimonial home as she was being continuously harassed by her husband Raja, father-in-law Pappu Choudhary and mother-in-law Smt. Premrani Choudhary vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29701502/
1 Premrani Choudhary in connection with demand of dowry of Rs.15000/- and a motorcycle.

entities.label: PRECEDENT

sentences.text: She was being continuously subjected to cruelty in connection with aforesaid demand.
Consequently, she died under mysterious circumstances within two years of marriage 4 .
Learned counsel for the applicant has submitted that applicant has not committed any offence.
She is innocent.
She has been falsely implicated.
She is mother-in-law.
It is submitted that main allegations are against husband and not against the mother-in-law and father-in-law.
Therefore, it is prayed that the applicant may be released on bail.
5. On the other hand, learned Panel Lawyer has opposed grant of bail to the applicant and has submitted that deceased had died within two years of marriage in matrimonial home.
There are clear-cut allegations against the present applicant also about causing harassment and torture to the deceased in connection with demand of dowry.
Therefore, he has prayed for rejection of bail application.

6. Considering the totality of evidence and material available on record and the fact that deceased had died within two years of marriage, I am of the view that it is not a fit case for grant of bail.
Therefore, this fourth bail application too filed on behalf of the applicant - Smt. Premrani Choudhary is dismissed.

(DINESH KUMAR PALIWAL) JUDGE mrs. mishra Smt. Premrani Choudhary vs The State Of Madhya Pradesh on 16 August, 2023 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/29701502/
